literal: Permanent home has not been formed, alas, inside the body in a temporary shelter which stayed to the life.
translation: Alas, has the life that resides in the temporary shelter of the body not yet found a permanent home?
modern: உடம்பாகிய தற்காலிகமான குடிசையில் தங்கியிருக்கும் உயிருக்கு, நிலையான ஒரு வீடு இன்னும் அமையவில்லையோ!
explanation: This couplet contrasts a temporary shelter ('tuccil') with a permanent home ('pukkil'). The body is described merely as a temporary, rented corner where life resides for a short time. The poet wonders with pity ('kollō') whether life has not yet found a permanent dwelling, since it keeps moving from one temporary body to another. This highlights the transience of physical existence and the inevitability of death.
